name: dual-core-1-E2
written_before: any E2 score. Two execution-only smoke runs (L1000 T fold 1, SciPlex3 A fold 2) printed counts, problems, live-check matches and timing only; no calibration, risk or decision metric was computed.
after: E1's analysis (research/dual_core/protocol.json) was read; its keep rules chose the world model below
exposure: development screen on the 20 protocol-v2.1 tasks, exposed in blocks 2-6 (E-DATA1 ran the same belief planner on these episodes)

world_model.aggregation: rrt_precision (inverse inner-CV error) for several prompts
world_model.fit: StrictInContextWorld: source, kappa, tau by strictly nested inner group CV; reference (s, k, e) shared with the reference world

arms.reference: block-2 belief planner + reference world (must reproduce E-DATA1 belief traces)
arms.incontext: same planner + StrictInContextWorld reading purchased prompts from the ledger

policies.P1: naive: abstain when the raw risk forecast of the chosen action exceeds alpha
policies.P2: improved agent: abstain above the largest grid threshold whose calibration-fold unit-weighted wrong-among-decided rate is at most alpha
policies.P3: Learn-then-Test: fixed-sequence Hoeffding-Bentkus tests of E_unit[wrong - alpha x decided] <= 0 at delta, strictest threshold first

E2.risk: sum over hypotheses of belief(h) x P(reading matches the other hypothesis | h, chosen action), recorded before the purchase
E2.alpha_reason: the validator's registered maximum wrong-elimination rate (dynamic_world_model/protocol.json)
E2.crossfit: test fold f; calibrators and thresholds fitted on the other four folds only (splits.crossfit_roles)

primary.calibration_after_selection: per dataset and planner, on its own held-out selected steps: cross-fitted Platt NLL minus raw NLL, unit mean, 95% interval below 0; and calibrated observed/forecast interval containing 1
primary.agent: per dataset and planner: P2 held-out wrong-among-decided <= alpha (point estimate) and P2 - P0 wrong-among-decided 95% interval below 0
primary.world_on_selected_steps: per dataset and planner: incontext - reference NLL of the realised reading under the true hypothesis on identical selected steps with at least one prompt, unit mean, interval below 0
primary.interaction: 2 x 2 (world x {P0, P2}) on identical episodes: interaction contrast of coverage and of wrong eliminations, unit bootstrap; synergy is claimed only if the coverage interaction interval is above 0 and wrong eliminations are not worse

secondary: raw observed/forecast on selected steps (E-CAL1 continuity)
reliability by risk bin and by tier
decision outcomes and measurements, descriptive only
reproduction of E-DATA1 belief traces by the reference arm
E2.aggregation: units as in protocol v2.1; 10,000-draw unit bootstrap, seed 20260927; per dataset (tiers pooled)
E2.E3: blocked: registered E-DATA1 failure rule ('stop planner-superiority work on these data'); decision outcomes are descriptive

claims_not_allowed: a finite-sample guarantee beyond P3's stated assumptions (exchangeable units)
